lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5 to 6 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs. The centroids are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern with a mean vertical inter-blob distance slightly greater than the horizontal distance between columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like anchor system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible running longitudinally along the flank, each defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a distinct transition from the large, discrete lateral blobs to a high-density field of significantly smaller, low-contrast punctate markers.
